biography:
Passionate about the ongoing energy transition that is reshaping our world. I am driven by a strong desire to create lasting, cost-effective, and pragmatic solutions that foster the growth of the renewable energy industry.

With a wealth of experience in US natural gas markets, US power markets, South American power markets, and European power markets, I offer a comprehensive perspective that spans across various regions. This breadth of expertise enables me to navigate the unique dynamics of each market. In addition to my energy knowledge, I have a proven track record in contract negotiations, client management, and team development, further enhancing my ability to drive success in the industry.

If you are interested in exploring the energy industry, exchanging ideas, or expanding your network, I invite you to connect with me.
